verdicts.label: TRUE
verdicts.what_is_true_en: India's Chandrayaan-3 mission successfully landed on the Moon's south polar region on August 23, 2023. This made India the first country to land in that region and the fourth country overall to land on the Moon.
verdicts.reasoning_en: The claim is fully supported by multiple high-quality sources. NASA (ws-6) and India's space agency, ISRO (ws-1), both confirm that the Chandrayaan-3 mission landed near the Moon's south pole on August 23, 2023. Universe Today (ws-4) explicitly states this made India the first country to land at a lunar pole. A fact-check from BOOM (fc-1) further supports this by debunking a competing claim that China was the first to land in the region. There is no credible evidence contradicting the claim.
